dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a moderate concave curvature forming a shallow parabolic spline from the mid-point to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a broad pixel radius at the highest vertical point of the fin.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Acute slope of approximately 35 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal midline.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.8:1 ratio of estimated base width to vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Broad convex arc with a smooth, large-radius curvature extending from the blowhole region toward the rostrum.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, blunt projection with a pixel length roughly equal to its basal thickness extending from the melon inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse inflection point of approximately 145 degrees visible at the transition between the melon and the rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct V-shaped notch visible on the lower third of the dorsal fin trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant specular highlights along the dorsal-lateral surface caused by directional overhead lighting, obscuring fine skin texture.
